title: Teams and Roles
html:
Goal: settle who uses which account, then have admin build a real company structure (department → project → member) and add four accounts, each with a project role, to 零售客服 (Retail service), the project the flywheel runs in. The server checks separation of duties by account on every sign-off in the next six phases, so this chapter decides whether the flywheel is really done by different people.

The department and projects in this scenario keep their Chinese names in both languages, so every participant types the same values. The English meaning follows each name in parentheses.

Prerequisites

  • You have completed Environment setup and console tour: at least one team member can sign in to the team's console V3 as admin.
  • You have completed Roles and separation of duties: you know the four global roles and the project role templates, and you checked that the release mode of workspace default is gated.

1. Agree on the team's main console (5 minutes)

Teams have 4–5 people. The organizer deployed one environment per team, so the team's main console is the ConsoleUrl the organizer gave you: everyone opens ConsoleUrl/v3 and works there. Sign-offs, admissions and releases are only done by different people when the whole team works on the same console. Pick the main-console holder by a simple rule (the lowest seat number in the team); they sign in as admin and do sections 3 and 4 of this chapter.

You can also take part alone: as in the roles chapter, sign in to the five accounts in five browser profiles (or private windows) and play each role in turn. The server still checks separation of duties by account, so switch to the matching account's window for every sign-off.

2. Roles and accounts (5 minutes)

The server enforces separation of duties by account (user id): whoever writes the criteria cannot sign them, whoever labels cannot decide the calibration, and whoever requests a release cannot sign it. Each role must be held by a different person with their own account; sharing one account between several people turns separation of duties off.

Role Account Project role in 零售客服 Phases and actions
Developer developer Developer Builds and deploys the agent, drafts and publishes the criteria, runs evaluations and regressions, sets up drift monitoring, generates and applies optimization proposals
Business owner biz-owner Business owner Signs the criteria, compiles and seals the golden set, admits candidate samples, decides the judge calibration
Release ops release-ops Release ops Moves endpoints, signs (or blocks) the release, approves waivers, rolls back when needed
Domain expert sme Domain expert Second labeler in calibration; writes correct answers through the reviewer link
Facilitator / admin (the team lead can double up) admin Not needed (administrators can manage every project) Builds the structure, adds members, approves registrations, checks the release policy, creates calibration labeling tasks, writes Cedar policies on the Gateway, reviews costs and decision records, keeps time

Use the seeded accounts the organizer gave you: the main-console holder hands the passwords of developer, biz-owner, release-ops and sme privately to the matching team members, and everyone uses only their own. With more than five people, or to use your own names, have admin create accounts or approve self-registrations as in section 4 of Roles and separation of duties, then add the new accounts to the project in section 4 below.

3. Build the structure (admin, 10 minutes)

This workshop uses the customer care center of a company as its example:

Department: 客服中心 (Customer care, customer-care)
  Project: 零售客服 (Retail service, retail-service)   ← the flywheel runs here
  Project: 旅行客服 (Travel service, travel-service)   ← only for the team lab, to show isolation between projects
Workspace: Default (us-east-1)

A project is a data and permission boundary: agents, knowledge bases, criteria and golden sets each belong to one project, and each member has their own project role in each project. A department collects projects together, and the project switcher in the top bar groups its options by department. A new agent must belong to a business project that has a department; the workspace default project Default can no longer hold new agents, which is why the flywheel runs in 零售客服.

When several teams share one console, each team creates its own project (for example team 3 creates t3-retail-service); the department can be shared. Still prefix resource names with the team number, for example agent t3-hotel-concierge.

3.1 Create the department

  1. As admin, open Modules → Configuration → Departments (/v3/departments) and click New department.
  2. Fill in Name 客服中心; ID customer-care (2-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; cannot change later); Description 处理零售和旅行业务的客户咨询 (handles customer questions for the retail and travel businesses). Click Create.

Expected result: the toast "Department 客服中心 created", and a new row in the list. The row actions are Administrators & workspaces, Edit, Archive and delete; this chapter does not need a department administrator.

3.2 Create the two projects

  1. Open Configuration → Projects (/v3/projects) and click New project.
  2. Fill in:
    • Name 零售客服, Project ID retail-service;
    • Department 客服中心;
    • Description 零售与电商的智能客服，飞轮主线在这里 (the retail and e-commerce customer service agent; the flywheel runs here);
    • Enable in workspaces: tick Default · us-east-1 (pick at least one workspace);
    • leave Project owners empty.
  3. Click Create. Create 旅行客服 (travel-service) the same way, also in Department 客服中心.

Expected result: two new rows in the project list. Click 零售客服 to open the project detail. Its tabs are Overview, Members, Roles, Workspaces, Shares, Settings and Audit; the Overview stat cards show Members, Agents, Workspaces and My keys here (22 for admin). Once the second project exists, a Project switcher appears in the top bar to the right of Workspace, reading Project Default · admin access.

4. Add the four accounts to 零售客服 (admin, 10 minutes)

  1. In the project detail of 零售客服, switch to the Members tab and click Add member.
  2. Type developer in the search box, click it in the candidate list, set Role to Developer, and click Save. The toast reads "developer added".
  3. Add biz-owner (Business owner), release-ops (Release ops) and sme (Domain expert) the same way.

Expected result: the members table has four rows, all with Source Direct. The Keys column shows how many keys each person holds in this project:

Member Effective role Keys
developer Developer 12
biz-owner Business owner 8 (7 after the next step)
release-ops Release ops 10
sme Domain expert 2

4.1 Take "Manage criteria" away from the business owner

The biz-owner row shows a ⚠ Combined duties chip: the business owner template holds both Manage criteria criteria.manage and Sign criteria criteria.sign. The server still refuses "write it and sign it yourself" at signing time, so this is not an error; but in this workshop developer drafts the criteria and biz-owner only signs them, and the split is clearer if biz-owner cannot edit:

  1. Click Edit on the biz-owner row.
  2. Tick Adjust keys for this member (overrides). Two groups of checkboxes open: Project keys (6) and Agent and lifecycle keys (16).
  3. Untick Manage criteria criteria.manage, leave everything else as it is, and click Save.

Expected result: the toast "biz-owner updated". The row's Overrides column shows -criteria.manage, Keys drops to 7, and the ⚠ Combined duties chip is gone. The 7 remaining keys are Use project.use, Write project.write, Sign criteria criteria.sign, Admit to golden set golden.admit, Decide calibration judge.calibrate, Eval run eval.run and Grant own access identity.grant.

A project role applies only in its own project. The same biz-owner still works with the keys of their global role (member) in the Default project, and project keys do not show on the Agent permissions card of the account detail.

This chapter adds no members to 旅行客服; the team lab uses it to show project isolation.

5. Everyone switches to 零售客服 (everyone, 3 minutes)

Each team member signs in with their own account (or reloads the page) and looks at the Project switcher right of Workspace in the top bar:

  1. Open the switcher. Its options are grouped by department: 零售客服 sits under 客服中心, and each option reads "project name · your role in that project".
  2. Pick 零售客服.

Expected result: for developer (tested), the top bar reads Project 零售客服 · Developer; after a reload it is still 零售客服, so the choice is remembered.

Before every later chapter, check that the top bar project is 零售客服. The Default project cannot hold new agents, and an agent created in another project does not show up in 零售客服.

零售客服 has no network profile or storage bound yet (the seeded workshop-private and workshop-files are bound to the Default project only). In the next chapter, Platform configuration, admin binds them to 零售客服.

6. Using this table in the flywheel

The steps of the next six phases say "biz-owner signs" or "release-ops signs the release". That means the team member holding that account: they do their step in their own browser, and everyone else reloads their own window to see the result. The table on the Agent-DLC flywheel group page lists the main accounts of each phase, so check which people a chapter needs before you start it.

Checklist

  • The whole team can open ConsoleUrl/v3 of the same main console, and each role is held by a different team member with their own account
  • Department 客服中心 and its projects 零售客服 and 旅行客服 all exist
  • The 零售客服 members table has four rows, developer, biz-owner, release-ops and sme, with the project roles Developer, Business owner, Release ops and Domain expert
  • The Overrides column of biz-owner shows -criteria.manage, with no ⚠ Combined duties chip
  • Every team member's top bar reads Project 零售客服 · <role>

Troubleshooting

Symptom Cause Fix
No Project switcher in the top bar The platform has only one project, or this account belongs to only one project Check that both projects from section 3.2 exist and that section 4 added the account to 零售客服
零售客服 is missing from the switcher The account is not a member of 零售客服 yet admin uses Add member on the Members tab of 零售客服
An account is missing from the Add member candidates The account is still pending approval, or has no access to the Default workspace Approve it as in section 4.2 of Roles and separation of duties, or grant default under Workspace access in the account detail
biz-owner sees no Sign / Admit buttons The top bar project is not 零售客服, or the project role is wrong Switch to 零售客服; check that the Effective role in the members table is Business owner
Creating a project says "Pick at least one workspace." Enable in workspaces is not ticked Tick Default · us-east-1
